title: GrowWithHR Industrial Relations Wave 5G Governed Standing-Orders Source-Readiness Catalogue

sourcePack.name: GrowWithHR Industrial Relations standing-orders and transition source-identity snapshot
sourcePack.notes: The Industrial Relations Code and Central Rules reuse existing Wave 5A source-identity fingerprints. Wave 5G adds curated official source identities for commencement, removal-of-difficulties transition, the 2026 amendment Act, Model Standing Orders, Maharashtra draft rules and the standing-orders authority notification register. These new records are source-identity-only pending exact controlled full-file Drive mirrors; the Maharashtra rules remain draft-only.

limitations: The Wave 5G catalogue remains needs-legal-review and is not a standing-orders applicability, worker-threshold, establishment-classification, certification, authority, dispute, termination, strike/lock-out, retrenchment, closure, penalty, prosecution or remedy determination.

Only organisation-level source route, Code/amendment/commencement, Central Rules, Model Standing Orders, Maharashtra draft-source, draft-final reconciliation, threshold-source, classification, certification-process, authority, transition and specialist-escalation statuses plus controlled references are eligible for retrieval context.

Retrieval cannot treat a draft State rule as final, infer worker counts or establishment classification, adopt/certify standing orders, select a forum, decide saved rights or pending cases, adjudicate a dispute or change the deterministic decision.

chunks.title: Industrial Relations standing-orders chapter source boundary
chunks.text: The Industrial Relations Code contains the standing-orders framework in Chapter IV, including section 28 application language and sections 29–39 on model standing orders, preparation, certification, appeals, registers and related matters. Wave 5G uses this material only for source readiness and does not decide whether Chapter IV applies to a customer or whether any worker threshold is met.

chunks.title: Model standing orders and certification source boundary
chunks.text: Sections 29–35 provide model-standing-order and certification-process context. Wave 5G records whether the relevant sources and process controls are present but cannot select a sector, adopt text, certify standing orders, approve modifications or choose a customer-specific certifying or appellate authority.

chunks.title: Industrial Relations repeal and savings source boundary
chunks.text: Section 104, read with the 2026 amendment, is retained as repeal-and-transition source context. Retrieval cannot decide saved rights, pending cases, forum continuity or the customer-specific legal effect of earlier standing orders or proceedings.

chunks.title: Central Rules standing-orders source boundary
chunks.text: The Industrial Relations (Central) Rules, 2026 contain the Central standing-orders procedure in Chapter IV, Rules 10–18. Wave 5G records this Central source and procedure readiness only; it does not establish that the Central Rules govern a customer or validate any standing-order filing, certification or modification.

chunks.title: Central legacy-rule supersession and savings boundary
chunks.sectionReference: G.S.R. 342(E) preamble — supersession subject to savings
chunks.text: The Central Rules supersede specified legacy Central rules to the stated extent, subject to savings for matters already done or omitted. Wave 5G treats that clause only as transition-source context and does not resolve State variations, saved proceedings, prior certifications or customer-specific legal effects.

chunks.title: Industrial Relations Code commencement context
chunks.text: S.O. 5320(E) appoints 21 November 2025 for commencement of the Industrial Relations Code. Retrieval may explain this source date but cannot turn commencement into customer-specific standing-orders applicability, forum selection or a substantive employment outcome.

chunks.title: Industrial Relations transition continuity order
chunks.text: The December 2025 Removal of Difficulties Order addresses continuity of legacy adjudicatory institutions during the transition. Wave 5G records that transition source only and cannot choose a forum, determine jurisdiction or decide the status or merits of a pending dispute.

chunks.title: Industrial Relations Code 2026 amendment transition boundary
chunks.text: The Industrial Relations Code (Amendment) Act, 2026 amends section 104 and provides statutory-authority continuity language. Wave 5G uses the amendment as transition-source context only and cannot determine saved rights, pending-case outcomes, authority jurisdiction or customer-specific repeal effects.

chunks.title: Model Standing Orders 2026 source boundary
chunks.sectionReference: Model Standing Orders, 2026 — mine, manufacturing and service sectors
chunks.text: The Ministry notification register includes Model Standing Orders, 2026 for mine, manufacturing and service sectors. Wave 5G records model-order source availability only and cannot classify a customer into a sector, select model text or determine whether a customer's standing orders conform.

chunks.title: Maharashtra Industrial Relations draft-rules boundary
chunks.sectionReference: State draft rules for Code on IR, published 28 April 2026
chunks.text: The Maharashtra Labour Department currently lists State draft rules for the Industrial Relations Code. Wave 5G retains that record only as a draft State source identity; it cannot be treated as final or operative, and a final Maharashtra instrument must be separately acquired, fingerprinted and approved.

chunks.title: Standing-orders certifying and appellate authority source boundary
chunks.sectionReference: Ministry notification register — section 2(g) certifying officer and section 32 appellate authority
chunks.text: The Ministry notification register identifies standing-orders authority notifications under the Industrial Relations Code. Wave 5G records authority-source readiness only and cannot select the competent officer, territorial jurisdiction or appellate route for a customer.

chunks.title: Deferred Industrial Relations dispute and separation boundary
chunks.sectionReference: Chapters V–XIV outside bounded standing-orders source readiness
chunks.text: Wave 5G deliberately excludes notice-of-change, industrial disputes, arbitration, strikes and lock-outs, lay-off, retrenchment, closure, unfair labour practices, penalties, prosecution, worker-level termination and remedies. Those matters require later bounded packs or specialist review and cannot be inferred from this standing-orders source-readiness profile.
